mainEntity.name: What is a recruitment funnel conversion rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the percentage of candidates who progress from one hiring stage to another.

mainEntity.name: How do you calculate offer-to-joining conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Divide the number of candidates who joined by the number who received offers, then multiply by 100.

mainEntity.name: What is a good recruitment conversion rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no universal rate. Results vary by role, industry, hiring channel and selection requirements.

mainEntity.name: Can employers use the calculator for bulk hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It can help analyze recruitment stages for high-volume hiring campaigns.
